name: Fresh Sheds
description: Independent dealer of wood portable buildings and engineered steel building kits — sheds, barns, garages, workshops and barndominiums.
dealerNotice: Fresh Sheds is an independent authorized dealer. Every building we sell is produced by one of our manufacturing partners and ships direct from their plant.
